R2: evaluate(..., seed_lists) is required (TypeError without; ValueError unless witness / erase / pres are non-empty integer lists); P-RET, P-CHAN and the NULL / SHUF / POS P-CAL arms must run the witness list exactly, P-OBS a non-empty prefix of it (FD-T031-W1), P-ERASE (S and S-LEAK) the erase list, P-PRES the pres list; a mismatch refuses the node SEEDS_NOT_REGISTERED:<node_id> (<predicate>). A refused P-CAL arm -> P-CAL BLOCKED, and with P-CAL BLOCKED every subject is UNQUALIFIED ('P-CAL BLOCKED: ...'). CLI --seeds is required and reads SEED_LISTS.json ['seeds'].

R3: P-ERASE triples must have world regimes (pre_a, pre_b) = (0, 1) (recomputed from the seeds by W15, never the receipt) and S / S-LEAK must run identical triples (ERASE_SHAPE); a P-PRES warm-up must draw the regime opposite to its seed's (PRES_SHAPE).

R4: the node id is rebuilt from the receipt's own subject digest, arm, predicate and world and must equal the manifest's node id (NODE_ID_FIELDS), checked after binding so a tampered receipt still reports BIND first.
